dedupe_keys.name: matchmaking for industrial symbiosis a digital tool for the identification quantification and optimisation of symbiotic potential in industrial ecosystems

description: The implemented matchmaking tool accepts liquid-waste volumes, material concentrations, market prices and raw-material consumption rates. It identifies and evaluates potentially profitable material exchanges between industries, using Sherwood-plot recovery-cost relationships. The authors describe outputs including transactions and graphs of material flows, margins and environmental effects. This gives an explicit resource-recovery decision function. It does not prove that a recommended exchange has been implemented or that the economic results apply to different plants. The publicly deposited paper describes the tool; a current executable endpoint, installation, source code and software licensing remain unknown. The source describes the stated resource-recovery analysis. The source authors provide this description through Zenodo, whose deposit declares CC BY 4.0 and public document access. Geographic and temporal coverage remain limited to the cases or observations explicitly described. Only metadata and file descriptors were reviewed; no document, measurements, model archive or code was read. Related components retain their source identities and uncertain experimental overlap. Document access and licensing do not establish executable availability or software rights.
